english.note: Use this when the person feels frustrated because they cannot change or control the situation.

examples.english: I can’t control this situation, so I’m really frustrated.
examples.traditional: 件事唔係我控制到，我都好無奈。
examples.jyutping: gin6 si6 m4 hai6 ngo5 hung3 zai3 dou2 ngo5 dou1 hou2 mou4 noi6
